note: agent-guard runs this CLI to distribute an already-scanned skill into every agent on the machine. GuardDog returns BLOCK on the four findings below; each is accepted with a reason AND neutralised by how the wrapper invokes the CLI (npm_config_ignore_scripts=true, reduced environment without credentials, local path as the source so no network fetch is needed). Any other finding, in this or a later version, stops delegation and the built-in installer takes over.

findings.reason: husky is the package's own git-hook tooling for development. npm runs `prepare` only on publish/pack, on an argument-less local `npm install`, on `npm install <folder>` and for git dependencies -- never for a registry tarball and not under npx. The wrapper additionally sets npm_config_ignore_scripts=true, so no lifecycle script can run at all.

Documented feature: the CLI reads a GitHub token to install skills from private repositories. agent-guard passes a local directory, so no token is needed, and the delegated process runs with a reduced environment that contains no token variables.
Same private-repository code path as GITHUB_TOKEN, reading the GitHub CLI's variable. Not present in the reduced environment the wrapper passes.
Agent detection: the presence of COPILOT_* variables identifies a GitHub Copilot session. The value is used as a signal, and the variable is not present in the reduced environment the wrapper passes.
